subject: Park cleanup details
text:
Hey everyone,

Squeezing this in before the client call. Still finishing the venue quotes, so let's pick the date by six and assume we are doing the park cleanup unless I say otherwise. I have the sign-up sheet almost ready, but I need one person to bring the trash bags and one to coordinate parking directions. Can I get quick yeses back in this thread? If no one claims the bags by then, I will just stop at the store on the way. Sorry for the really scattered note; my internet keeps dropping, and I do not want to lose time with details. I will send the final plan as soon as the quote comes back.

Thanks,
Jules
